description: Permit ledger page 6 (scanned, handwritten entries): the one word OCR read confidently in a line of scrawl is no heading (#83).

assertions.why: A handwritten ledger has no heading.
What OCR kept of a mostly unreadable line (a signature, a struck-out passage) is no heading (#83).

assertions.xfail_without_ocr: Without an OCR runner, the page is not rasterized by OCR, so the page scan sees another page.
assertions.why: A ledger entry over a cluster of the table's rules is no signature (#85).
